brief:
Demonstrations across Palestinian territories continue to mobilize public pressure on international institutions, according to Middle East Eye. Protest movements have maintained momentum despite the prolonged conflict in Gaza, with organizers emphasizing their role in generating hope among Palestinians and compelling institutional responses to the situation.

Activists argue that sustained demonstrations serve as a critical tool for drawing attention to conditions in Gaza and maintaining pressure on regional and international bodies to intervene or alter their policies regarding the territory.
dek: Israel's genocide in Gaza continues. So must the protests Submitted by Maha Hussaini on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 16:27 Demonstrations gave Palestinians hope and pressured institutions to act.
title: Palestinians sustain Gaza protests amid ongoing conflict
